claim_boundary: Post-open one-case source capacity smoke on single_lift_cloth with manual disjoint prefix validation. A pass authorizes only a separately locked source panel; it is not deployable, independent, confirmatory, or state-of-the-art evidence.
hypothesis: A causal sparse tracker can witness the relative gauge of a dense CoTracker3 displacement block, while disjoint prefix identities can safely decide whether a graph-smooth persistent readout field transfers beyond the witnessed identities.

identity_boundary.selection_rule: Provider identities are inherited from the frozen TAPNext++ competence control. Among all remaining identities, the two with greatest finite availability on frames [88,121) are validation identities, ties by identity id. Every other identity is assigned to future scoring. Future values and future availability are not used.

dense_field.observation: CoTracker3 displacement from frame 68 to frame 87 minus selected physical-baseline displacement over the same frames.
dense_field.relative_gauge: Median dense-minus-primary-provider displacement over the last five prior common rows, after each provider is differenced from its first common row. Absolute gauge is not used.
dense_field.basis: Frozen rank-4 graph basis from the earlier sparse-state source diagnostic.
dense_field.correlation: All accepted dense rows form one correlated block. Reliability changes relative row weights, but total information mass is fixed to graph rank, so duplicating rows cannot increase confidence.
dense_field.prior_reliability: CoTracker3 source quality, multiview reprojection error, camera count, and validity only.
dense_field.innovation_processing: The dense-versus-physical displacement innovation enters once through four robust graph-projection iterations.
dense_field.application: The accepted rank-4 field is held constant in readout space from frame 88 onward.
dense_field.fallback: Any support or validation failure returns the selected physical baseline byte-for-byte.

future_gate.pass_action: Permit a separately frozen, fixed-method opened-source panel before any fresh-object evaluation.
future_gate.fail_action: Close this sparse-witness dense-field arm without threshold, identity, basis, cap, provider, or window tuning on this case.

forbidden: reading the future-score artifact before the prediction seal exists
using validation or future values to choose provider identities
using future availability to choose validation or scoring identities
using the PhysTwin innovation to create perception reliability
counting dense pixels as independent evidence
changing the graph rank, correction cap, identities, windows, or gates after prefix or future scoring
opening, inspecting, modifying, or rerunning held-v8 artifacts or processes
describing a one-case opened-source pass as deployable or state-of-the-art evidence
